a16z's first employee Scott Kupor on how Michael Ovitz's CAA playbook became the model for a16z:

"When you would go show up for a pitch at CAA in 1990 where I think they had like 90% market share, they would sit around a table, and Michael would introduce you as Robert Redford and say, 'Look, meet my colleague who does nothing other than radio deals. "And we basically took the same model to the VC world. The VC world was a lot like that. You had a one-to-one relationship with John Doerr, who was fantastic at what he did."

"As the domains grew, the expertise needed just continued to grow."

"Let's hire GPs who are functional domain experts in the particular areas of investing they want, and then let's surround them with this phalanx of somebody who all they do all day long is manage CFO relationships, or CEO relationships, or VPs of engineering, somebody who all they do is government relations, or business development."

BREAKING: China’s PPI inflation rose +5.7% YoY in October, its largest YoY increase since June 2022.

This also marks its 3rd consecutive monthly acceleration.

By comparison, PPI stood at -3.6% in both June and July 2025.

The surge was driven by higher energy and non-ferrous metal prices, alongside growing demand for AI-related hardware, pushing factory costs higher.

Meanwhile, producer purchasing prices, which measure what factories pay for raw materials, energy and other production inputs, jumped +7.9% YoY, the largest increase since June 2022.

Inflation is back in China.

Martin Casado on how AI breaks The Mythical Man-Month:

"I really think the big disruption of AI is the fact that you can throw capital at problems. In the history of tech, you haven't been able to do that because it was always an engineering problem, which just doesn't scale. The Mythical Man-Month is the Mythical Man-Month for a reason."

"Ten years ago, if I had five founders show up and they asked for a billion dollars and I gave it to them, what would happen?"

"They would detonate, right? They would hire a bunch of engineers, and then you're really fucked, right? You can't throw capital in it."

"To me, the biggest shift, industrial-revolution-level shift with AI, is I can take 20 people and I can give them a billion dollars, and they can use that. Now, do they make $500 million from that billion or two billion? I have no idea. But the fact that you can productively use that money is so new and is so interesting."

HubSpot co-founder and CTO Dharmesh Shah says ChatGPT and Claude are the new browsers, and like browsers, they won't own the whole software stack:

🔥No official U.S. CPI YoY number today — but we can still estimate it.

Because of the 2025 government shutdown, BLS never collected October 2025 CPI data, leaving it unable to calculate the usual year-over-year comparison for today’s release.

We backfilled the missing October 2025 observations with Bloomberg-derived estimates. On that basis, headline CPI is running at roughly 4.02% YoY in October, up from 3.74% in September.

The contribution breakdown is also notable:

• Core services: +2.06 percentage points
• Energy: +1.33 pp
• Food: +0.41 pp
• Core goods: +0.19 pp
That comes alongside the official October monthly readings of +0.4% headline and +0.3% core, both above consensus.

Methodology: Missing September 2025 weights are estimated by updating December 2024 weights for subsequent price changes, with the same weights used for October. Missing October 2025 index values are estimated as the geometric mean of September and November 2025.

These are Bloomberg-derived estimates, not official BLS figures.
